Name: PET (potential evapotranspiration)
What it is: Weather-driven demand for water, from date, air temperatures and latitude

Name: E (evaporation multiplier)
What it is: Scales the PET given to the soil before any soil limit
What it does NOT mean: Millimetres of evaporation; a measured quantity

Name: d (exchange coefficient)
What it is: Scales how fast neighbouring layers trade water
What it does NOT mean: Physical diffusivity (m² per s), drainage rate, water amount, sediment parameter

Name: Evaporation-stress scale
What it is: Top-layer moisture at and above which the moisture multiplier is 1
What it does NOT mean: A cut-off where evaporation stops; the residual

Name: Residual moisture
What it is: Lowest moisture the model lets the layer reach
